# Mohamed Ali - AI Solutions

> Founder of AI Solutions. AI automation and workflow specialist based in Egypt,
> serving clients across Egypt, the Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar), Jordan,
> Turkey, and Germany. 32+ production automation and AI agent systems delivered
> across 10 industries, including aluminum & manufacturing, GTM/B2B sales,
> hospitality, real estate, healthcare, and education.

Mohamed Ali is a GTM Strategist and AI Systems Architect with 13+ years of
commercial leadership in pharma and B2B (managed a 1.2B EGP annual target, led
a 24-person field team, government tenders and national health programs). He
designs the strategy, builds the AI systems himself, and ships the product.

Services: n8n workflow automation, AI sales agents (WhatsApp, Instagram,
Messenger), lead generation engines, clinic booking automation, contract risk
analysis, e-commerce order & inventory automation, GTM & B2B sales strategy,
custom web apps built with Lovable (Vibe Coding).
